resources.string: During a goal you start, Jarvis reads visible app labels, fields and controls across apps. Its local language model can launch apps, change media volume, navigate and scroll. Review a proposed tap or text edit in the floating panel. Tap Stop at any time. Goals and screen text stay on the phone and are held in memory for the run.

While enabled in Jarvis, reads YouTube screen labels and button IDs on this phone and taps a recognized, visible ad-skip control. Screen content is never saved or shared. Pause in Jarvis or turn off access here.
